criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.evidence: source and axe: native table, thead, tbody and th; axe table rules pass on all 10 stories
criteria.note: scope is optional on Th; set it on row headers.

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast passes on all 10 stories

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: scroll width: LongContent (480px) and RTL scroll sideways at 390 and 320
criteria.note: Data tables need two dimensions, so the reflow exception applies.

criteria.name: Non-text contrast
criteria.evidence: computed: sort icon #044D6C and info icon #0A5159 on white, both above 3:1

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play) and Playwright Tab run: Tab skips the sortable header (a clickable th with no focus and no key handler) and stops first on the info tooltip button
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): put a button inside a sortable Th.

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run: the info tooltip button gets a 2px #000 outline

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: the tooltip opens beside the button and leaves it visible

criteria.name: Target size (minimum)
criteria.evidence: measured: info button 16x17, under 24x24 but nothing else within 24px (spacing exception); header cells 372x45

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: axe button-name (critical) on WithSortableAndTooltipIcons, Hover, Focus and Keyboard: the header's info tooltip button has no name; source: a sorted header sets no aria-sort
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): aria-sort on sorted headers; the name comes with the IconTooltip heal.
